Virtual Assistant (Part-Time)

Sample TechnologiesRemote (Worldwide)Posted Sep 17, 2026

RemotePart-timeNo ExperienceDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for a part-time virtual assistant supporting a small distributed team. The role covers calendar management, inbox triage, travel booking and light research, roughly 20 hours per week.

Responsibilities

  • Manage calendars across multiple time zones and prevent scheduling conflicts
  • Triage a shared inbox and draft first-pass replies
  • Book travel and prepare simple itineraries
  • Keep internal documents, trackers and folders organised

Requirements

  • Strong organisational habits and attention to detail
  • Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
  • Available for at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern time
  • No prior VA experience required — a short paid trial task is part of the process

Benefits

  • Flexible hours around a fixed overlap window
  • Fully remote, work from anywhere
  • Paid trial task before a longer commitment
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-time role

Skills

Calendar ManagementEmail ManagementGoogle WorkspaceResearchOrganisation
